Alex —

Thanks, attaching a lightweight MAP and a dependency matrix (attached). High level:

- Week 0 (now): Procurement intake + security questionnaire review — Phaedrus owner: Alex; Redwood owner: Ben.
- Week 1: Security evidence handoff (SOC2 summary, data flow diagrams) — Redwood: Laura (Security); target: 2026-04-28.
- Week 2-3: Legal redlines to MSA/DPA — exchange, quick-pass redline expected by 2026-05-08.
- Week 3-4: Order Form commercial review and sign-off; procurement to confirm PO flow — target signature: 2026-06-04.

Key constraints:
- If Legal requires a custom data residency clause, that will add ~1–2 weeks.
- On-prem packaging (air-gapped installer) is scoped as optional pilot work and is a separate delivery lane — will not block signature but will be a separate acceptance milestone.

I'll loop in Laura on security evidence. Ben — can you confirm SOC2 artifact availability and whether we can produce a high-level DF diagram by 4/28?

Olga

Laura/Olga/Ben —

I skimmed the 'legal_flags' tab and flagged a few items that will need TL discussion:

1) Data processing agreement: standard Redwood DPA covers our hosted API but for Private (VPC/on-prem) we request a minimal customization around transfer restrictions; propose a one-paragraph addendum rather than wholesale DPA changes.
2) Indemnity cap language: propose limiting to fees paid in 12 months rolling (we've used this in EU deals).
3) Escrow/Source code requests: we should push to standard support play + SLA credits; full escrow will add legal cycles.

Recommendation: schedule a 30-min legal handoff with Phaedrus Legal next week (suggest 2026-04-28 or 04-29). If we hit those dates for evidence and initial redlines, June 4 signature is achievable barring new custom clauses.

I can join the call.

— Jonas
